_team_scope_note: PMN records the team in two different fields depending on issue type: cf[10040] 'Epic Team\s' is set on epics, cf[10098] 'Team Name' on stories/bugs/tasks (and some epics). Filtering on either one alone silently drops most of the data -- as of Aug 2026, cf[10040] matched 41 Ascenders issues and cf[10098] matched 680. any_clause is the union, used for epics and the all-issue-type AI series; bug_clause is what bugs actually carry.
_forecast_note: 26.4 closed at exactly 22 -- hit the target on the nose. History (0, 0, 1, 13, 22) still shows a ramp, decelerating (diffs +12, +9), so the trend continuation for 27.1 is ~28. Capped per Kobi's 2026-10-07 rule at 125% of 26.4's actual (22 * 1.25 = 27.5), so 27 is used instead of the uncapped 28. 2026-10-08 India-festival adjustment: the team reported 29 leaves last quarter vs 87 this quarter (+58 leave-days). Against an estimated ~19 core contributors (distinct people closing 3+ issues in the last 90 days) that is a 5.2% capacity loss on a like-for-like 60-weekday window (58 / (19*60 - 29)), so the capped 27 becomes 26 (25.6 rounded). If the 29/87 figures cover Ascenders and CXCO combined (~30 people) the loss is 3.3% and the target is still 26. 2026-10-14: Kobi asked for the target to match the epics currently assigned to the release, excluding Removed. fixVersion 27.1 holds 24 such epics (0 more are Removed), so the target is 24. This supersedes the history-based figure and the 125%-of-26.4 cap above, and it is scope, not a delivery prediction: it moves as epics are added to or removed from 27.1. 2026-10-18: Kobi changed the rule to epics on the release with Commitment Type = Committed or empty, excluding Stretch (and Removed). fixVersion 27.1 currently has 7 Committed + 9 with no value = 16 (8 Stretch and 0 Removed left out), so the target is 16. This replaces the all-epics figure from 2026-10-14. It is scope, not a delivery prediction: it moves as epics are added, removed or classified.
forecast_basis: epics on 27.1 that are Committed or have no Commitment Type, excluding Stretch and Removed (16)
_recipients_note: Recipient addresses are NOT in this file -- the repo is public. They come from the ASCENDERS_DASHBOARD_RECIPIENTS secret (semicolon-separated); the test audience comes from PMN_DASHBOARD_TEST_RECIPIENT.
_edct_note: EDCT is computed from Jira changelogs by edct_from_jira.py, not copied from Power BI: average calendar days in In Progress/Validation, excluding flagged days and Maintenance-category epics. Validated against the R&D Efficiency KPI-TREND row for PMN Apr-Aug 2026 (7/24/26/23/7) - exact match on all five months. Set edct_count_done_day true to follow the written definition instead, which reads ~1 day higher.
